name: megascenes-photo-filter
description: Turn a photo from your MegaScenes library into a new look as a whole: cartoon, anime, watercolor, oil painting, sketch or vintage film.

interface.longDescription:
Pick a photo from your MegaScenes library and choose the look: cartoon, soft anime, watercolor, oil painting, pencil sketch, pop art or 1970s film. You get the whole picture redrawn in that style, with the same composition and the people still recognizable.

ChatGPT lists your recent photos, tells you what the new version needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The restyled photo opens in the chat and stays in your library next to the original.

For profile pictures, gifts, posts and prints.

Limitations: looks are described in general terms, not by a studio, film or artist name. Only your own photos or ones whose people agreed, never a famous person. The photo must already be in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: List the photos in your library
Restyle a whole photo in the look you pick
Return the new version in the chat
defaultPrompt: Turn my latest MegaScenes photo into a watercolor painting
Make my last photo look like a pencil sketch
Give my portrait photo a soft hand-painted anime look

positive.prompt: Which photos do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Turn the selfie I uploaded to my MegaScenes library into a watercolor painting. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one restyled photo with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can restyle a photo here?
positive.expected_behavior: The photo filter models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Turn the selfie I uploaded to my MegaScenes library into a watercolor painting. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my restyled photo on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my restyled photo to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
